CZCPI Index.name: Czech Republic CPI
CZCPI Index.des_notes: Consumer prices (CPI) are a measure of prices paid by consumers for a market basket of consumer goods and services. The yearly (or monthly) growth rates represent the inflation rate.

CZPPA10M Index.name: Czech Republic PPI Food Produc
CZPPA10M Index.des_notes: Producer prices (output) are a measure of the change in the price of goods as they leave their place of production (i.e. prices received by domestic producers for their outputs either on the domestic or foreign market).
